title: GLOBAL TO SUPREME — MASTER ECOSYSTEM CATALOG
scope: Bharat se Global World tak; Basic/Normal se Supreme tak. Planning taxonomy only; not a claim of implemented services, live integrations, or operational systems.

expansion.policy: Expand only with meaningful, individually defined, non-duplicate entries. Do not manufacture entries merely to reach the target.

safety_boundary: Adult-content scope is limited to lawful content involving consenting adults. Minors, exploitation, non-consensual sexual material, child sexual abuse material, and illegal content are prohibited and require prevention, reporting, and moderation controls.
architecture_note: Catalogue records are planning and reference metadata only. Each future implementation requires defined ownership, scope, interfaces, privacy/security controls, legal compliance, and tests. Avoid duplicate or unnecessary nested directories.

ecosystem_module_index.policy: Module references are architecture metadata and do not count as unique catalogue entries.
